finding: The claimed B_R fidelity bound mixes gate-coordinate derivatives/Hessian with response-coordinate norms, so it is false under its own stated assumption; repairing the score/bound coordinate would change the load-bearing Impact-Redundancy mechanism and is therefore an obstacle hole, not a wording patch.
why_not_repaired: An honest repair must redefine either I_b and the remainder in gate coordinates or the derivative/Hessian in response coordinates. That changes the packet ordering, H/R split, and central decomposition claim, which exceeds patch-only coherence repair.
verbatim_step_quote: Under the explicitly local assumption that J_val has gate-Hessian norm bounded by the training-only measured L_g along the replacement path, the downstream fidelity loss is conditionally bounded by B_R=Σ_{b∈R}I_b+(L_g/2)||δ_R||²; B_R and its interaction remainder are reported against the full pilot, making the error decomposition rather than the partition label the contribution.
executed_evidence: Executed excerpt: delta=0.25; gradient_gate=1.0; L_g=0.0; J(g)=g; actual=abs(J(1)-J(0))=1.0; written_B_R=abs(gradient_gate)*delta+(L_g/2)*delta**2=0.25. J(g)=g has gate-Hessian 0 everywhere, so it satisfies the stated L_g envelope, yet 1.0 > 0.25. The gate-coordinate Taylor expression on the same instance is |gradient_gate|+(L_g/2)*1^2=1.0.
structural_requirement: (a) Identifying condition: any successor must use one explicit perturbation coordinate throughout the score, first-order term, path, and Hessian remainder, and must derive the reported bound for removal in that same coordinate. (b) Available sources are the existing packet gates, autograd of J_val, validation-only pilot responses, and a predeclared replacement path; formal-OOD entities remain excluded from selection, and real-device observations are unnecessary for this algebraic condition. An exact/safely upper-bounded path Hessian may be computationally expensive; if it is not available, the bound must be dropped and the score treated as empirical rather than inheriting an unpriced guarantee. (c) Salvage the packet-gate instrument, held-out validation metrics, projection-residual diagnostic, permutation control, and matched-budget uniform baseline; discard the current mixed-coordinate I_b/B_R formula and every guarantee that depends on it. The executed evidence does not identify which replacement coordinate will perform best.
